verdict.rationale: n8n's docs include a dedicated Credentials section listing credential types for many services (GitHub, GitLab, Okta and others), which shows the product manages connection credentials itself. The only governance evidence is a generic claim of role-based access and an "Admin roles" pricing item; nothing shows credentials being shared with teammates or access controlled per credential. Missing for 10: documented credential sharing with users or teams, per-credential usage permissions, evidence that the role-based access applies to credentials, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can store connection credentials centrally, share them with my team, and control who can use which credential

citations.quote: Self-host or deploy securely with role-based access, audit trails, and support for sensitive data
